sloka: कदा नु खलु माम् साध्वी सीता अमर सुता उपमा ।स उत्कण्ठा कण्ठम् आलम्ब्य मोक्ष्यति आनन्दजम् जलम् ॥६-५-२०॥।।
transliteration: kadā nu khalu mām sādhvī sītā amara sutā upamā ।sa utkaṇṭhā kaṇṭham ālambya mokṣyati ānandajam jalam ॥6-5-20॥।।

translations.english: When will Sita, the chaste woman, who is like the daughter of Gods, cling to my neck, and indeed shed tears of joy?
